database.note: SQLite keeps no per-table modification time; every table below reports the modification time of this file.

combined_pfam.fasta.description: All PF00355 (Rieske) proteins downloaded from Pfam; the raw protein input of the whole pipeline.

gbk_files/.description: Downloaded GenBank records; the source of every genomic coordinate, neighbour gene and neighbour protein sequence.

ROs_71_Clean/.description: The 71 hand-curated reference RO alpha subunits with their HMM models and motif columns; defines type assignment, the catalytic motif test and every evidence tier.

cluster_ecology.csv.description: Hand-curated substrate, substrate class, ecology note and confidence per reference type.

chemistry.csv.description: Hand-curated substrate name, SMILES, product, reaction, reaction class, chemical family, PDB entry and literature source per reference type.

RieskeDB71.hmm.description: Pressed HMM library of the curated references, used for type assignment by bit score. The count is not written here: it changes when a type is added, and a stale number in a provenance map is worse than none.

family_hmms/.description: Pfam models for neighbouring-gene families (transposase, recombinase, regulator), fetched by accession; kept apart from component_hmms/ so the two scans stay separate questions.

component_hmms/.description: Pfam models for operon components (beta, ferredoxin, reductase); input of operon derivation.

cluster_sdp.description: Alignment columns that separate the variants of a type, with the gating statistics that qualified each column.

gene_category.description: Functional category assigned to each neighbour by annotation-text rules (regulator, transposon, ro_beta, ring_cleavage, ferredoxin and so on).

leaf.mtime_note: mtime of roar.sqlite; SQLite keeps no per-table timestamp, so table-level staleness cannot be detected from it
leaf.description: Homogeneous leaves produced by recursively splitting heterogeneous types; a leaf is the variant level of this database.

leaf_profile.description: Variant profile per leaf: median identity, genus spread, plasmid and transposon rates, the distinctive neighbour products and a human-readable label.

leaf_sdp.description: Residue signature of each leaf at its type's discriminating columns, and how far it departs from the type consensus.

ro.description: One row per RO alpha candidate with its genomic coordinates and strand. annotate_ro.py later fills the HMM verification columns (ro_cluster, model_coverage, rieske_intact, is_confirmed) and build_operons.py fills ro.sequence.

ro_fts_docsize.description: FTS5 internal document size table for ro_fts.

ro_fts_idx.description: FTS5 internal term index for ro_fts.

subfamily.description: CD-HIT subfamilies within each type, with size, representative and top genera.

cluster_assignment_conflicts.csv.description: Each type pair's colliding sequences with their evidence levels, so a collision between two distant members can be told from a real one.

cluster_ecology_stats.csv.description: Per-type ecology and mobility table: transposon and plasmid rates, genus count, synteny entropy and operon completeness, joined to the curated substrate class.

cluster_identity_matrix.csv.description: Assignment-boundary signal, NOT a similarity measure: the highest identity between any two leaf representatives assigned to different types.

cluster_reference_identity.csv.description: Identity between the curated reference sequences of each pair of types, over the columns where both carry a residue.

cluster_variance.csv.description: Within-type identity spread per RO type: median, quartiles and the fraction of members below the homogeneity target.

cooccurrence.json.description: Co-occurrence of RO types within 10 kb and on the same replicon, against a permutation null that holds per-replicon counts and type totals fixed.

etc_by_cluster.csv.description: Electron transport chain composition per RO type.

evidence_by_cluster.csv.description: Evidence tier distribution per RO type.

family_scan.json.description: Neighbouring genes classified by Pfam model instead of product name -- transposase, recombinase and regulator families -- and how that reading differs from the product-name rule.

habitat.json.description: Habitat composition of the database and habitat crossed with substrate class, reported both per entry and per distinct organism name, plus which keyword decided each habitat assignment.

leaf_profiles.csv.description: Flat export of the per-leaf variant profiles.

leaves.csv.description: Flat export of the leaf table (one row per variant).

motif_stats.json.description: Conservation of the eight defining alignment columns (Rieske ligands, bridging acid, catalytic triad) across all confirmed ROs.

novel_candidates.csv.description: RO members whose identity to every curated reference falls below the novel-type threshold.

novel_high_confidence.csv.description: The same candidates as a table: nearest reference, identity to it, variant and organism.

novel_high_confidence.fasta.description: Protein sequences of the high-confidence novel candidates, written under the rule documented in evidence_tiers.py.

null_model.csv.description: Neighbourhood enrichment of each gene category against random same-size windows drawn from the same replicon population.

operon_validation.json.description: Test of the operon convention against a background of every gene in the same windows, with a negative control and a 50-500 bp threshold sensitivity sweep.

promoter_architecture.json.description: Intergenic length of divergent regulator pairs against divergent non-regulator pairs, at three levels and within genus.

provenance.json.description: This manifest: the origin, inputs, size and age of every table and analysis file.

redundancy.json.description: Sequence redundancy: unique sequences versus entries, copy-number distribution and the effect of deduplication on every count.

reference_pairs.csv.description: All-versus-all identity between the 71 curated references with each pair's substrates; the calibration behind the claim that no global identity threshold implies a shared substrate.

regulation_by_cluster.csv.description: Regulatory architecture distribution per RO type.

representatives.csv.description: One representative sequence per leaf and per type with its catalytic-site verification result.

representatives_by_cluster.fasta.description: Representative protein sequences, one per RO type.

representatives_by_leaf.fasta.description: Representative protein sequences, one per leaf; the input of the phylogeny.

sdp_positions.csv.description: Candidate specificity-determining alignment positions per type from the first-pass variant analysis.

ssn_edges.csv.description: Sequence similarity network edges from diamond all-versus-all above the identity cutoff.

ssn_nodes.csv.description: Sequence similarity network nodes with their type and leaf annotation.

stats.json.description: Hypothesis tests behind the headline findings, each run at entry, unique-sequence and type-by-genus level with effect sizes.

subfamilies.csv.description: Flat export of the CD-HIT subfamily table.

substrate_predictability.json.description: ROC and precision of the rule 'above X % identity means the same substrate', measured over all curated reference pairs.

transposon_by_genus.csv.description: Transposon adjacency per genus crossed with RO type, used for the mobility analysis.

tree_all.nwk.description: FastTree phylogeny of the 71 references plus one representative per leaf, built on the hmmalign-trimmed catalytic core.
